verdict: Instagram lead generation is working — 259 leads at roughly $27 each, well below legal industry norms.
diagnosis: The credit repair campaign is efficient, but only 17 accounts engaged organically and the Google Business Profile is driving zero direction requests this period.

signals.headline: 259 leads generated this period
signals.detail: The active lead-gen campaign produced 259 form submissions, with 206 confirmed via the pixel. Volume is healthy for a single ad set.

signals.headline: Cost per lead near $27
signals.detail: Total spend of $6,962 divided by 259 leads lands well under the $164 Meta legal median. Efficient acquisition for this vertical.

signals.headline: 1,358 landing page views logged
signals.detail: Of 1,914 link clicks, 1,358 reached the landing page — a 71% arrival rate. Funnel is holding up between click and page.

signals.headline: 118 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: The local listing drove 118 phone taps this period. Reviews now total 973 at a 5-star average — a strong trust asset.

signals.headline: Only 29 Instagram followers total
signals.detail: Organic reach hit 4,024 but the account gained just 2 follows. Paid is carrying the entire acquisition load.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Legal Meta leads typically run $67 to $254
benchmark.body: Meta ads for legal services show a median around $164 per lead, with a range of $67 to $254 depending on practice area. Justice Consumer Law's ~$27 cost per lead sits far below that band.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Consumer debt and credit repair searches hold steady through summer as households reconcile post-tax-season balances. Legal cost per lead on Meta has shown swings up to $123 between August and September historically.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Firms shifting to short-form video creative
competitor.body: Consumer law competitors are moving budget toward talking-head video and Reels in 2026. Static image ads still convert but lead quality reportedly improves when prospects watch 15 to 30 seconds of video first.

recommendations.title: Test a short video version of the top static ad
recommendations.detail: The Static-2 creative is working. Consider filming a 20-second attorney explainer using the same hook to see if video lifts lead quality without raising cost.

recommendations.title: Add a Spanish-language ad variant
recommendations.detail: Organic queries include Spanish debt-rights searches. Worth testing a translated ad set given the existing English campaign efficiency and clear bilingual demand signal.

recommendations.title: Reply to recent Google reviews to boost local presence
recommendations.detail: The profile has 973 reviews at 5 stars but zero direction requests. Responding to recent reviews, including fee concerns, can improve map visibility and trust.
